title: Ethiopian Chickpea Skewers
description: A flavorful and healthy Ethiopian-inspired dish featuring chickpeas and vegetables, perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the oil, Ethiopian spice blend, and herbal notes.
Add the chickpeas, onion, bell pepper, tomato, and cucumber to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Thread the chickpea mixture onto the skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the vegetables are tender and lightly charred.
Transfer the skewers to a plate and serve hot.
